rdzong nang dgongs ba rang shar/khong mi nyag mgar thar du skyes shing / snga rjes su zhing chen bod yig slob grwa dang mtsho sngon slob gso slob gling sogs nas mthar phyin zhing / gser rta rdzong slob 'bring du dge rgan gyi phyag las la zhugs/ sa de gar slob gso dang slob khrid kyi bya ba lo ngo nyer gnyis ring la bsgrub pa'i zhor du 〈'dzin bdag gi bya ba ji ltar sgrub 〉ces pa'i rgya yig gi rtsom mig dang /〈bod yig rmongs sel myur lam 〉zhes pa'i slob grwa'i nang khul gyi slob deb rtsom sgrig byas pa/ 〈khams phyogs ston bshad/〉 rtsom sgrig byas pa sogs rtsom yig phyogs la yang bya ba du ma zhig bsgrubs dang sgrub bzhin yod/

gleng gzhi/phran ni mi nyag mgar thar du skyes shing / mi nyag mgar thar gyi yul 'bangs dang 'grogs 'dres gting zab yod/ ma zad yul de'i dmangs srol gang mang zhig la rgyusamanga' cung che/ de'irkyen gyis 'dir dmangs srol gyi skad cha'i sgyu rtsal 'ga' zhig debatu bsgrigs pa yin/ spyir dmangasakhrod na rin thang gzhal du med pa'i rig gnas sna mang dar la/ 'tsho ba dngos dang 'brel ba'i sgyu rtsal kun 'dus kyi rig gnas gang yin yang dmangs khrod nas thog mar mgo 'bus pa zhig red/ khyad par sa cha nga yin yang yul de'i thun min gyi khyad chos 'bur du thon pa'i dmangs srol rig gnas gang mang re mnga' la/ de'i thun min gyi khyad chosade yul gzhan dang gzhan tshor bsdur na ngo mtshar zhing bsam yul las 'das pa zhig red/ nga'i pha yul mgar thar gyi yul 'bangs 'di la dus yun ha cang ring bo ring bo zhig gi ring nas ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi blo gros kyi nying bcud las byung ba'i rin bral nor bu lta bu'i dmangs srol rig gnas gang mang zhig yod pa'i nang nas 'dir skra rtse'i chu thigs phra mo'i mtshon byed —1—

tsam du yul lha mchod srol dang ston bshad/ lcag gi bshad pa sogs kyi dpe srol 'di tshor dpe brjod kyi tshul du re zung bkod pa lags/dmangs srol rig gnas 'di tshos sa de'i yul 'bangs kyi lha yi dad 'dun dang 'tsho ba'ingos 'dzin/ mi'i kun spyod bsam blo dang rin thangalta tshul sogs dzim dzibazhin mtshon thub/ des pha yul gangs ljongs kyi yul lung 'ga' zhig gi dmangs srol rig gnas gang mang zhig gi rgyab ljongs la dngos su lta thub par byas yod la/ mi/bas sngon ma dang sngon ma'i mes po'i 'tsho ba gang mang zhig la phyir lta da thuba' ༵༵/ sdud byed mkhan dang deb du sgrig mkhan nga rang la mtshon na nyams myong dang rig gnas chu tshad gang thad nas ha cang zhan pasanor 'grul shor yod pa ches shin tu mang po yod nges pa la snying nas dgongs 'gal med par zhu/ /rang shar nas/

dkar chagagleng gzhi/ (1)dar bstod dbyangs can rgyud mang / (5)chang bstod thos pa kun grol/ (7)lcag bstod thos pa dga' skyid/ (10)bgastonadangagatamabashad kyibyungababarjod pagaser gyi me long / (13)yul bstod bdud rtsi zegs ma/ (19)sde 'bangs la bstod pa dri za'i pi wang / (21)khyim gzhi la bstod pa nor bu dga' 'khyil/ (27)gtam gzhung gi 'go brjod/ (31)gtam gzhung dngos/ (36)bag gos la bshad pa mu tig phreng mdzes/ (76)bag rta la bstod pa dri za'i rgyud mang / (80)gsol mchod dpyid kyi rgyal mo/ (84)shis brjod bkra shis g.yang 'khyil/ (91)—1—

snyed su sti 55 tha// legs so/de ring bkra shes pa'i nyi ma/phun sum tshogs pa'i skar ma/rgyal phur 'dzoms pa'i 'phrod sbyor/ gnam la bkra shis pa gnam beeḍūrya'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bkra ba/sa la bkra lhas pa sa padma 'dab brgyad la ze'u 'bru bzhad pa/phyogs la bkra lhas pa phyogs mtshams bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi ra ba/yul la bkra shis pa yul stod smad padma'i 'dab ma ba'ad pa/phyugs la bkra lhas pa phyugs dkar nag nor bu dga' 'khyil/mi la bkra shis pa mi rgan gzhen ma ṇi rang 'grub/de lta bu'i bkra lhas shing phun sum tshogs pa'i dus skabs 'di la/gnas chen po mi nyag bzhag brag dkar po/ri rtse gangs ri dkar po rtse mo dgung la bsnyegs 'dra/seng ge dkar mos stobs la 'gran zhing g.yu ral ngom pa/bod zhwa dkar can gyi bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel/—1—

ri rked spang ri ser bo gser gyi gzhong bar mar khu bkang 'dra/bya khu byug gis dbyangs la 'gran zhing btagag sgro ngom pa/bod kyi gdung rgyud dkar bo chos dad che ba'i rten 'brel/ri mtha' nags ri sngon po rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs dgung la 'phyur 'dra/rgya stag ngar mas rtsal la 'gran zhing 'ja' ris ngom pa/gdong dmar bod kyi gzhon nu'i dpa' rtsal rgyas pa'i rten 'brel/g.yas na gangs chu dwangs mo/bu dang tsha bo'i lus stobs rgyas pa'i rten 'brel/g.yon na rdza chu dwangs mo/gdung rabs bzang bo chad pa med pa'i rten 'brel/'dabs na na chu dwangs mo/rta nor lug gsum sha shed rgyasapa'irten 'brel/thang 'dabs padma 'dab brgyad/thang chen dpal be'u bzhi bsnol/thang dkyil mar khu'i mtsho mo 'din/sde bzang bo mgar thar byams pa gling /lo re bzhin du pha mes dar srol/yul lha'i mchod pa/—2

dgra lha'i dpung bstod/yul ba'i dga' ston/dge sne/ba sdig spang /glu len gar rtsed sogasakyi srol rgyun bzang po yod pa'isde ba 'dir/de ring yang sngon gyi las smon bzang po/bzang thog gser gyi sa bon/lha lam gser gyi 'brel thagagadung dang sde ba khag gnyis/yan lam gser gyi zam pa/man lam dar gyi mdud pa/de bskyangs song ba'i skabs su/dang po nyi shar gyi rtse mo/rten 'brel gyi 'go ma/bdag gzhi mgron gnyis kyi spyi ma/gtam ku re gnyis kyi sgo 'byed/nas 'bru sngon mo'i nying khu/bdud rtsi kun gyi snying po/ro bcud ldan pa'i nas chang de/—3

bkra shis pa'i dar dkar dang bcas pa/nged zhang po rnams la drangs dang /(a zhang so so'i ming bzung na'ang chog)nged zhang po rnams kyi kha lce padma'i gdan thog la/gtam gyi me tog 'brungs ba'i lo rgyus yod la//

dar bstod dbyangs can rgyud mang /ko legs so/bkra shes pa'i dar kha 'dil lha dar dkar po dang / btsan dar dmar po sogs mdog sna tshogs kyis rten 'brel sna tshogs mtshon pa'i lo rgyus mang yang /da de ring gi skabs su babs pa'i/dar dkar nyin mor bde legs 'di la/ bstod pa lan gsum re brjod na/dar mgo la bkra shis rtags brgyad 'dzoms pa/bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi rtags yag pa/dar rked la rgyal sras sna bdun 'dzoms pa/rgyal sras sna bdun gyi gzugs yag pa/dar rnga la tshe ring rnam drug 'dzoms pa/tshe ring rnam drug gi bskor yag pa/lha bla ma mjal ba'i mjal dar/gong dpon po mjal ba'i mjal dar/drin pha ma mjal ba'i mjal dar/nged tsha zhang 'dzoms pa'i 'dzoms dar/—56

steng lha la phul na dngos grub dang mgon skyabs gnang /bar btsan la phul na sdongs grogs dang rgyab gnon mdzad/'og klu la phul na longs spyod dang phywa g.yang bstsal/skyabs bla ma la phul na tshe thag ring zhing byin rlabs thob/'go dpon po la phul na khrims ra rgyas lhang dgra lha 'khor/drin pha ma la phul na thugs dgongs dgyes shing zas lha 'khor/nged zhang po la phul na spro ba 'phel zhing kha lce bde/mdor na bkra shis bde legs 'byung ba'i rten 'brel du leṭa so//

chang bstod thos pa kun grol/oṃ legs so/bdud rtsi kun gyi snying tsho nas 4 /'di la bstod pa lan gsum re brjod na/'di lo la bsnyal ba'i lo 4 yin/lo oṃ bdud rtsi kham pa yin/zla la bsnyal ba'i zla 4 yin/zla oṃ bdud rtsi zil ma yin/zhag la bsnyal ba'i zhag chang yin/sa 4 bdud rtsi sul ba yin/gangs can yul gyi nas yin/shāje/nyenazug zu ri 4dnga'ag na srad pa' sgrub chang yan/ge sar rgyal tsho gsol 4 yin/sngags pa rnams kyi bum 4 yin/

mkhas pa rnams kyi gtam chang yin/mgron tshur yong rnams kyi bsu oṃ yin/mgron phar 'gro rnams kyi skyel chang yin/gtam ku re 'byed pa'i lde mig yin/glu rtsed rig gnyis kyi sgo wod yin/gnyen nye bo sgrig pa'i nye rtags yin/skyid gnam lo gsar ba'i zas mchog yin/nged tsha shad 'dzoms pali'adzoms chang yin/steng lha la mchod na mgon skyabs gnang /bar btsan la mchod na sdongs grogs mdzad/'og klu la mchod na phywa g.yang bstsal/pha a khus na dgra lha 'ashesar/stag shar bas man dpal rtsal rgyas/ma bu mos na zas lha 'khor/gtam rngayand dus na kha lce bde/glu len dus na skad ngag bde/—8

sems skyid dus na tshe thag ring /blo bde dus na rig pa rgyas/nged zhang pos na gtam sgo 'byed/da ngasayon to brgya dang ldan pa'i bdud mi'adi/dang po nam mkha'i lha la mchod/mi mgo nag rnams la bde skyid stsol/de nas gnyan po btsan la mchod/mi mgo nag rnams la sdongasagrogs mdzod/de nas gdengs can klu la mchod/mi mgo nag rnams la phywa g.yang stsol/de nas tsha zhang rnams kyis gsol/tsha spyo bo'i gto gyi sgo mo phyedazer ba ltar//—96

lcag bstod thos pa dga' skyid/༈ ཿstelegs so/da lcag tshan bsam pa'i don 'grub la/bstod pa lan gsum re brjod na/shing tsan dan smug po'i lcag yu bzos/lcag mgo la ser po gser gyis shan/lcag rnga la dkar po dngul gyis shan/lcag rked la dmar pozangs kyis shan/'brong bre ser ko ba'i lcag rgyud dras/ma mkha' 'gro brgya yis lcag rgyud blas/lha tshangs pa dkar pos lcag rgyud btags/sha yu mo'i lpags pas lcag long dras/ma bu mo brgya yis lcag long bsgrims/—10

lha khyab 'jug chen pos lcag long btags/lhatsa( rgyan padmas rab gnas byas/rje rin po che yi phyag rten yin/smad rgya nag rgyal po'i khrims lcag yin/nged zhang po rnams kyi gtam lcag yin/gdon sna tshogs dam la 'dogs byed yin/mi rgod po klad pa rdung byed yin/rta rgod po lam la dgod byed yin/rta 'gros ma 'gugs pa'i zhags pa yin/lcag rgyal ba bsam pa'i don 'grub yin/don mi 'grub skal ba gcig kyang med/gser ser po bre la 'jal nas nyos/dngul dkar po rgya mar 'jal nas nyos/lcag dang po brel ba stod la brel/stod dbus gtsang bla ma'i chos la brel/brel gcig brel gnyis smad la brel/—11—

smad rgya nag rgyal po'i khrims la brel/brel gnyis brel gsum bod la brel/bod kha ba can gyi rta la brel/brel gsum brel bzhi zhad la brel/ngedas zhad rnams kyi gtam la brel/lcag mgo yid bzhi nor bu yin/lcag rked bkra shis 'khyil ba yin/lcag rnga bsam pa'i don 'grub yin/ci bsam lhun gyis 'grub pa'i smon lam shog

bag ston dang gtam bshad kyi byung ba brjod pagaser gyi me long // sa bde legs su gyur cigad gna' mi bod kyi gtam dpe la/tshig gsum tshig gis ma bshad na/drin pha ma yin rung brda mi 'phrod/gom gsum gom pa ma spo na/sgo phyi nang yin rung thon mi thub ba'i lo rgyus ltar/da de ring bag ston dang gtam bshad kyi srol rgyun/rgya che min rung mdor bsdus tsam ma bshad na/nged tsha zhang gnyis kyi bar du brda mi 'phrod mod/des na de yi srol rgyun cung zad bshad na/oṃ legs so/—13—

dang po steng ma lha nas dar/lha yi bu mo rnal 'byor ma dang /klu chabu chung klu rigs thod dkar gnyis gnyen 'grigabag ston klu yi yul la byas/bag ston gyi srol rgyun de nas dar/bag rogs dbyangs can sgrol mas byas/bag rogs byung ba de nas byung /bag rta lha rta dkar po byas/bag rta'i rtsa ba de nas byung /lha yi ljon pa la lha dar btags/mda' dar gyi rtsa ba de nas byung /slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis g.yang 'bod/g.yang 'bod kyi rtsa ba de nas byung /lha tshangs pa dkar pos gtso byas pa'i/lha rigs drug brgya dang drug cusasku zhang byas/ma shad gi lugs srol de nas byung /klu phrug mthong ba kun grol gyis gtso byas pa'i/—14

glu brgyud bzhi brgya dang bzhi chus tsha bo byas/tsha bo chalugs srol de nasabyung /sbrang char zegs ma'i skyel chang byas/skyel chang gi rtsa ba de nas byung /klu chu gtsang ma'i bsu chang byas/bsu chang gi rtsa ba de nas byung /klu rdzasarin chen sna sngas 'bab rten byas/'bab rten gyi rtsa ba de nas dar/lha phrug thos pa dga' bas gtam bshad/gtam bshad gyi rtsa ba de nas dar/klu phrug mthong ba kun grol gyis slar zlogazhu/slar zlos zhu srol de nas dar/klu yi pho brang mi 4ra rdo rje'i gling du/zhag ma brgya dang rtsa brgyad la/yas gtam dang mas gtam bshad/snyan pa'iglu dbyangs len/mdzes pa'i bro gar 'khrab/—15

mgyogs pa'i rta pho rgyugs/dpe de dang bstun nas gnam sa gnyis ka gnyen bsgriṭa/sa padma 'dab brgyad du bag ston byas/bag ma sprin gyi me tog byas/bag rogs chu 'dzin dkar po byas/bag rta g.yu 'brug sngo mosabyas/rta khrid dpyid kyi rgyal mosabyas/mda' dar sprin gyi phreng ba byas/dgung nyi ma ser po yis g.yang 'bod byas/zla ba dkar pos gtso byas pa'i/rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyisar zhang byas/a skyes sa 'dzin lag pa sogs kyis tsha bo byas/sprin bcud dwangs mas skyel chang byas/nas chang gtsang mas bsu chang byas/'bru drug lo tog gis 'bab rten g.yung drung bris/skar ma smin drug gis gtam bshad/sa bdag legs pa'i sras kyis slar zlos zhu/—16

nor 'dzin dga' ma'i steng du/bag ston gyi ltad mo rgya chen spel/dpe de gnyis la bltas nas/rgya bod gnyis das gnyen bsgrigasate/rgya nag rgyal po thang tha'i krung gi sras mo/chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos khab tu bzhes/dbus kyi lha ldan yul du bag ston byas/rgya bza' 'un shing kong jo bag ma byas/rgya mo theng zhe'o yan gyis bag rogs byas/'do ba rlung gzhog can de bag rta byas/rgya zhin chen bco brgyad kyisatho zhang byas/bod khri skor bcu gsum gyis tsha bo byas/'bras dkar chang gis skyel chang byas/nas nag chang gis bsu chang byas/gser dngul gnyis kyis g.yung drung 'bab rten bris/rgya yi blon po li to tsung gis chos gtam bshad/bod kyis blon po mgar dam pas slar zlos zhu/—17

jo bo shākya mu zhes rdzong ba byas/dpe de dag la bstun nas khra mo gling dkar stod du/sga skya lo seng lcam 'brug mo de/gling ge sar rgyal pos khab tu bzhesanas/gling gi dpa' thul so sos yasagatam dang masagatam 'chad/dgon la dgon bstod dang chos la chosabastod/yul la yul bstod dang chang la chang bstod/nyin zhag bco brgyad la 'chad pa sogs/bag ston 'dzam gling la grags pa la pa'i/lo rgyus ha cang mang po yod mod/da shin tu rgyas par bshad na mang 'gro gi/mang song na 'dir tshoṭa kyi khrim pa thuṭa sun gi/'dzam gling gi nyi ma 'gang thung gi/rgyu mtshan des na de tsam zhig las bshad rgyu min/—18

yul bstod bdud rtsi zigs ma/sa legs so/da mgar thar byams pa gling la bstod pa tshig gsum zhig zhu na/gnas bzang bo shar stod bzhag brag dkar po'i mdun sar/gnam sngon por 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad shar ba/sa dog mor padma 'dab brgyad bzhad pa/bar lhun por bkra lhas rtags brgyad tshang ba/lhang ljon lhang g.yu yi lo 'dab rgyas sa/bya byi'u rnams kyis skad snyan sgrog sa/thang sngon por me tog sna tshogs bkra ba/'bu rkang drug tshogs kyis glu dbyangs len sa/skye rgu 'gro ba skyong ba'i bla ma zhabrungs sa/mdo sngags chos kyi bshes gnyen dam pa 'byungs sa/khamasagasum dbang la bsdu ba'i dpon po 'brungs sa/—19

rtsal drug lus la tshang ba'i dpa' bo 'brungs sa/lo lon rgan pa rnams kyis ma ṇi 'don sa/lo chung gzhen nu rnams kyis rig gnas slob sa/stag shar ba yongs kyis rta rgyug 'gran sa/ma sru mo rnams kyis g.yu byur 'dogs sa/chos 'jig rten gnyis kyi bya ba bsgrub sa/phyugs rta nor lug gis sa gzhi g.yogs sa/lo 'bru drug tshogs kyis ri bo brtsigs sa/thag ring rna bas go na smon lam 'tshor sa/thag nye mig gis mthong na yid dbang 'gug sa/yul stod smad kun gyis bstod pa byed sa/mdor na phun sum kun nas tshogs pa'i sa cha/mgar thar yul ljongs la bstod pa/tshig gsum brjod na de ltar legs so//—20

sde 'bangs la bstod pa dri za'i pi wang /༈ ཿstelegs so/da de ring nyi ma bzang po/skar ma bzang po/ bkra shis pa'i nyi ma/phun sum tshogs pa'i skar ma/gnam la 'ja' gur phub pa'i nyi ma/sa la padma bayid pa'i nyi ma/phyogs la dge mtshan shar pa'i nyi ma/pha bla mas bka' chos gsungs pa'i nyi ma/nang pha khus bdud rdzi'athung ba'i nyi ma/pho lo chung rta pho zhon pa'i nyi ma/ma bu mos rgyan cha 'dogs pa'i nyi ma/nged tsha zhang gtam tshogs 'chad pa'i nyi ma/kun la dga' snang skye ba'i nyi ma 'di la/—21—

ngas 'dir bzhugs kyi mi 'bangs la/bstod pa tshig gsum zhig zhu na/oṃ legs so/'dir mthong ltad mo la phebs pa'i mi rnams kyi nang na/brtsigs pa'i ri 'dra ba/brdungs pa'i mkhar 'dra ba/bzhedas pa'i lha 'dra ba/g.yu 'brug bzhin du ngar skad dgung na mtho ni/seng ge bzhin du g.yu ral phrag na 'phyor ni/khyung chen bzhin du gshog sgro mtha' na rgyas ni/rgya stag bzhin du dpa' rtsal lus la tshang ni/rgyal po bka' 'khor gyi dbang yod ni/'chad na smra lce yi ngag snyan ni/brtsod na lung rigs kyi ngar yod ni/rtsom na snyan ngag gi tshig sbyor yod ni/mtho ris lam la dge ba'i skas 'dzugs ni/—22

dam tshig chos kyi sgo mo 'byed ni/lha tshig gser gyi ri bo bzhengs ni/mu tig dung gi mchod rten brtsigs ni/mi sna skar tshogs ltar grangs mang ni/nyi zla ltar 'od gsal ba/gangs seng gi g.yu ral ltar 'jigs che ni/stag mo yi 'dzum drug ltar bkra yag ni/lung lag rtags kyi bdag po/las yo drang gi thig shing /phugs bden rdzun gyi shan 'byed/gcod pa gnam lcags kyi sta re/dra ba rno yi so le/mthon po mar la 'gugs pa'i shed yod ni/dma' mo dgung la 'jog pa'i shes rgya yod ni/mkhas mang rgyu skar gyi khrod na dung zla ltar gsal ba/ser skya drag zhan gyi khrod na mkhas pa spobs pa can/—23—

btsun pa nges 'byung can/skal ldan las 'phro can/mi bzang po yon to gyi rgyan yod ni/rta bzang po gyi ling gi rgyug yod ni/gos bzang po 'ja' rpā gyi 'od yod ni/zas bzang po bdud miyi ༄da yod ni/langs na gnas kyi ka ba nyan ni/bsdad na sa gzhi'i dkyil 'khor nyan ni/sku ri rab las mtho ni/gsung pi wang las snyan ni/thuṭa me long las gsal ni/yon tan can gyi bla ma dbus na bzhugs na/byin rlabs mdo khams yul la 'jug ni/sngags pa rnga rdung khams na yod na/rnga skad gshin rje lam na sgrog ni/dmag bu rta khrab gsum 'thab pa'i dus na yod ni/—24

dpa' skad 'dzam gling yongs la grags ni/gser khri gdugs can gyi bla ma yid bzhin gyi nor bu/bslab pa gsum ldan gyi bshes gnyen ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan/sdom pa gsum ldan gyi dge bshes bstan pa'i srog shing /sngags pa gnam lcags kyi phur bu dgra 'gog gi gshed ma/dus min 'chi bdag gi 'jigs skyob gso byed kyi sman pa/blang dor lkog gyur gyi gsal byed sa ris kyi rtsis pa/rno lha zhabrul ba med pa mo ba kun mthong gi sgron me/dgra 'dul gnyen skyong gi dpon po yul thub kyi don pa/bod zhwa dkar can gyi dbu 'phang bstod ni/dgra ber nag can la dma' 'bebs byed ni/mtshon rnon pos dgra sde phye mar 'thag ni/rta mgyogs pas bya 'phur kha yis zin ni/dge bshes chos g.yang gi bdag po/sngags pa lha srung gi bdag po/mkhas pa lte g.yang gi bdag po/ 25

phyug po nor g.yang gi bdag po/gzhen pa dpa' g.yang gi bdag po/rta pho mgyogs g.yang gi bdag po sogs/mdor na yon tan thams cad ldan yod ni/nyes skyon thamasacad spangs yod ni/phun sum kun nas tshogasayod pa'i/'dir mthong ltad mo ba rnams la/bstod pa nyung bsdus tsam brjod na de 'dra red//

khyim gzhi la bstod pa nor bu dga' 'khyil/gdung tshang gi khyim gzhi la bstod pa tshig gsum zhig zhu na// ma bde legs su gyur cigagadugs 'dra ba'i dgung 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/gdan 'dra ba'i sa padma 'dab brgyad/bkra shes rtags brgyad tshang ba'i ra ba na/sa mkhan brgya yis sa dpyad byas/bla ma rtogs pa can gyis rab gnas byas/dge slong 'dul khrims can gyis sa dgra btul/sngags pa dar nag can gyis sa bdag mchod/rgyab ri g.yu 'brug sngon mor bsnyen pa 'di/lo rgan tshe thag ring gi rten 'brel red/g.yon ri zangs sgo seng ge 'gyings 'dra 'di/khyim gzhi'i pha mgo mtho ba'i rten 'brel red/—27

g.yas ri glang chen sna ltar ring ba 'di/rigs brgyud chad pa med pa'i rten 'brel red/mdun ri bzhag brag rin chen spungs 'dra 'di/rgyu nor 'dzad mtha' med pa'i rten 'brel red/g.yas kyi chu bo g.yon du babs pa 'di/pha tsha bu gsum pho brgyud dar ba'i rten 'brel red/g.yon gyi chu bo g.yas su babs pa 'di/ma 'bri rgod gsum mo brgyud 'phel ba'i rten 'brel red/da gzhal yas khang la dpe byas nas/btsan po stag gi lo nas sa gdan brkos/zhi ba yos bu'i lo nas dma' sar bstod/brtan po glang gi lo nas rtsig gdan bzhagamagyogs pa rta yi lo nas las 'go brtsams/gnyan rdo smug po yis rtsig gdan bzhagabatsan rdo dmar po yis rmang gzhi brtsigs/lha rdo dkar po yis rdo khog brgyab/—28

klu rdo sngon po yis chu rag brgyab/rin chen sa yis kha rgyan brdungs/tshad na kun gyis ran khuzir/bltas na kun gyis yag khu zer/ka rdo gor mo g.yu rdo bzhagaka ba klu shing thang mos byas/gdung ma gnyan shing dmar pos byas/rin chen shel gyis dra mig brgyan/sa dkar zho spras chags 'dra 'di/dkar gsum zho 'o mang rtagasared/wa chu phyi la bskor ba 'di/gyod kha mchu phyi ru 'khor rtags red/gdung rnga nang la bskor ba 'di/rgyu longs spyod nang la 'khor rtagasared/dang po phugs kyi srung ma brtsigs/thab ka mi 'gyur g.yung drung steng /—29

thab rdo rigs gsum mgon po las/zangs ba bkra shis rtags brgyad btsugs/dngul skyogs rin chen sna tshogs kyis/dwangs ba(sa05 35ba bzang pa yagarin chen gser gyi zom 'di la/chu mig chu mgo khur pa yaga'abru rigs sna lngas bang mdzod gang /g.yas kyi rta ra yangs po mārta ma brgya bu brgya 'do ba'i gang /g.yon gyi thog ra yangs po mā'abri ma brgya bu brgya phyugs kyi gang /mdun gyi lug ra khra mo nang /lug ma brgya bu brgya g.yang gi gang /sgo lhas rtog khyi gzig khyi btags/phun sum tshogs pa'i khyim gzhi 'dil/bstod pa lan gsum brjod na de tsam zhig red//—30

gtam gzhung gi 'go brjod// de ring bkra lhas pa'i nyi ma la/'dir tshogs mgron po rnams kyi ngos nas bshad na/rig pa can gyi bu/ ri mo can gyi gos/rin thang can gyi rta/ rwa co can gyi 'bri/rigs dang rus rgyud phun sum tshogs pa'i/mi chen mkhas gragaba'ibazang gsum thams cad 'dus pa'i nang na/lung rtogs yon tan can gyi bla ma/bshad sgrub bstan pa'i srog shing /mkhyen brtse nus gsum ldan pa'i bshes gnyen/'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gnas/'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mkhas pa bstan palimadzes rgyan/lta sgom spyod gsum gyi sngags pa gsang sngags kyi rgyud 'dzin/dpe lung rgyud gsum la goms pa 'jig rten gyi rgan rabs/—31—

dpa' drug lus la tshang ba 'phong skyen rtsal gsum gyi dpa' bo/chos drug yid du 'ong ba bde dbus bzhun gsum gyi bu chung /rtogasargya dgung sngon las mtho ni/mthong rgya bar snang las yangs ni/de lta bu'i mgron po rnamasakyi mdun nasagatam gyi gleng slong gi tshig gasdo/ma/phyi lo ma rgya can gyi gtam/nang 'bras bu don can gyi gtam zhig bshad na/zla zhun lan brgyar byugs pa'i/shel dkar milhun poriphreng ba tshar du dngar ba'i/gangasarili'adab mas yongs su bskor ba'i/byang phyogasakha ba can miljongs 'dir/srid pa'i semasacan gnasatshul/dang por ston pa byon tshul/bar du bstan pa dar tshul/tha mar bka' drin che zhes/—32

rgyal rabs blon po byon tshul/'gro ba'i phan bde spel tshul/gnas bdag yul lha mchod tshul/mgyogs pa'i rta rgyug byasatshul sogasargyas par bshad na/rig pa shel dkar gyi me long la dran pa nyi zla ltar gsal ni/dang po gtam gyi dbu 'jog la mkhas ni/bar du gtam gyi rting gnon la mkhasani/tha ma gtam mibardzid chags la mkhasani/mkhas gsum dpe lung gis brgyan ni/rgyan gsum don gyi gzhi shes ni/bkod pa'i gtam skabs su bshad shesani/bshad pa'i don gsal ni/bshad byed kyi lce bde ni/bshad dus kyi ngag 'jam ni zhig gis/rgyan dam pa lha chos kyi dbu btsugs/chos mthun lung gis rgyab skyor/—33

bar du mgo nag mi chos gtsang mas gzhung bsrings/gtam mthun dpe yis sngon bsus/dgag sgrub rigs pas mtha' bcad nas/gtam snyan mo zhig tshangs pa'i dbyangs la drangs nas zhu dgos pa red mod/da mi nga dang nga 'dra ba/skyes thob kyi shes rab med pa/sbyangs stobs kyi yon tan zhan pa/mthong rgya dar skud las phra ba/thos rgyas long las dog pa/spobs pa yungabasagar las chung ba/dang po bris pa'i yig cha ma mthong /bar du 'don pa'i byang cha med gi/tha ma bshad pa'i smra lce mi bde/sems dran rig gi ngosal 'char dka' gilhag par 'dir tshogs kyi lta mkhan tsholizhal 'jigs che gi—346

mi chung nga 'dra bas gad kha lhan tu dka' gi mod/da gna' mi bod kyi gto dpe la/bya log can tsor na gar bab/rta long ma rgyug na gang mgyogs/mi mgo nag tshogs na gang shad//re/nga thodang/ji/ snroḥ/ /ji/ zeje gas pa' ga bzung na 'al ba gtam ra ba ltar/de ring bkra shes pa'i nyi ma 'dil/phun sum tshogs pa'i gto zhig gad na/bde legs yang ba'i rten 'brel yong rgyu red/

gtam gzhung dngos// ma legs so/brjod pa'i ngag gang zhig snyan zhing rna bar 'jebs pa/mdzes shing yid dang mthun pa/bzang zhing spro ba bskyed pa/de ni tshangs palidabyangs kyi yan lag yin pas/ngag gi sgrib pa spangs pa la 'byung ba shas che/brjed la non dang ldan pa/mtshar la bayid gad 'byin pa/bden la nges shes bskyed pa de/mi chos kyi phu thag chod pa la 'byung /mtshar la dad pa skye ba/snyan la mchi ma 'chor ba/—36

sems la nges shes skye bde/lha chosakyi phu thag chod pa la 'byung /mang la 'brel ba med pa/dpe dang don du 'gal ba/dpe mang khur du lus pa de/mi mkhas nga rgyal che ba la 'byung /zob la zad dus med pa/lus med yan lag mang ba/'brel med gtam gzhung ring ba de/rgan po.u tshugs can la 'byung zer la/oṃ legs so/da lha chos la shes gal che/mi chos la goms gal che/lo rgyus la zhib gal che/tshig ngan la non gal che/ bshad gad la 'jam gal che bas/—37—

thos pa'i mtha' rgya ma bcad na/chos bshad khol bus sa mi chod de/slar la dris na yang lan mi 'byung /goms pa'i gtam gzhung ma shes na/u tshugs tshig gis don mi 'grub ste/bshad rgya che yang nam phug pham/nges pa'i zhib cha med na/phyogs mthong tsam gyis dag cha mi thon te/zhib tu bshad na phug rdugs/non cha don gyi lcid med na/rnam 'gyur rtsub mos pha rol mi thub ste/wa kha dgra 'bod mi yis 'phya/'jam la mtshar ba'i nyams med na/gzhan mtshang zlos pa bshad gad min te/rtsed mo byas pa rtsod par stir ba yod pas/gnis bzang po rang la yod pa dang /8

shes goms cha yun du song ba zhig dang gnyis ka dgos/da gtam de dag thams cad kyang mdor bsdu na/skyon can dang skyon med gnyis la 'du/gtam skyon med de mkhas pa'i lha gral du dgos pas/de yi lo rgyus cung zad 'chad na/gtam de la'ang yas gtam dang mas gtam gnyis yod pas/yas gtam lha chos kyi gtam yin te/de yang bla mas chos bshad la lag len gyi don gtso che/chos khrims kyis chos bshad la lo rgyus kyi byung tshul gtso che bas/snga ma ni bka' rgyud sde dpang por bzhag pa'i/thos bsam bsgom gsum nyams myong dang 'brel ba zhig dgos/phyi ma'ang bshad pa'i skabs la babs pa/rang shes kyi mtha' chod pa/ nyan pa po che dgu 'dzom pa/gnas skabs kyi 'brel ba dang ldan pa zhig med na/mkhas mkhas che ba blun gzugs su 'gro ba'i dpe yod/da dang po chosakyilo rgyus de cung zad bshad na/—39

spyir ston pa sangs rgyas kyi byon tshul/skyob pa dam chos kyi dar tshul dang gnyis la 'dus/de yang gleng gzhi phun sum tshogasapa lnga dang 'brel ba zhig yin te/gnas phun sum tshogs pa tshal magha dha rdo rje'i gdan du/mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul bstan te/dusaphun sum tshogs pa gdul bya yongs su smin pa'i gnas shā/ba'akhu/mi rnams kyi tshe lo brgya dang nyi shu thub pa'i dus na/'khor phun sum tshogs pa sangs rgyas mjal ba skal ba dang ldan pa'i/gang zag rigs can gsum la/chosaphun sum tshogs pa sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum/gsang sngags phyi nang dang bcas pa/rjod byed kyi ngag dag pa gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pas/brjod bya yi don bzang ba lam bslab pagasum kyigand tshang ba/—40

chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong du gsungs/rjes 'jug 'phags pa'i gang zag rdo rje'i thugs dang ldan pas/mi brjed gzungs kyi dbang thob pa rang lam gyi sal gnas pa dang /'brasabu thob pa dag gisabaka'ibasdu ba gsum gyisagatan la phab/chos phun sum tshogs pa tshig tu bzlas/tshig la bshad pa dpe la bris te/'jug 'dod kyi gang zag 'chad pas rjes su bzung /rgol 'dod kyi gang zag rtsod pas tshar bcad/rjes 'jug gi gang zag la rtsom pas bstan rgyun bzhag nas/rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar du mdzad/de las bod gangs can gyi yul du lha sprul pa'i rgyal po/milirje tho tho rigazhaba' gyiring ladamapa chosakyidabubarnyes/lha gcig srong btsan gam po 'phags pa mig mi 'dzum pa/—41—

mngon sum mi yi rnam rol du byon te/bod ma sang 'dre'i yul du/'phags chen lha yi rgyal po mdzad/mtha' bzhi'i che dgu dbang du bsdus/yi ge dang bstan bcos kyi dbu btsugs/sku rten rin po che jo shag rnam gnyis spyan drangs/dga' bzhi'i 'phrul snang lha las babs pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/sangs rgyasakyi bstan pa'i srol btod/rgyal rabasalnga nas rje btsun 'jam pa'i rdo rje mi'i rje bor phebarbasdo pa/gnam lha babs kyi rgyal po/sa lhun grub kyi mnga' bdagamago nag bod kyi spyi rje/sprul pa'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan/pho brang 'om bu brag dmar du sku 'khrungs/—42

yab mes kyi yig tshang gzigs pas/dam pa'i chos kyi thugs bab byung ste/bdud blon gyi mdun gros rnam dpyod kyis tshar cad/za hor me tog gi gling nas mkhan chen byang chub sems dpa'/'dul 'dzin shārnya rakṣi spyan drangs te mdo sde rgyu 'bras kyi chos la thugs sbyangs/bal yul yang le shodanas tshurgyan sangasargyasoganyisapa bsusate/mkhan slob chos gsum gdan 'dzoms pas/nag phyogs kyi lha 'dre dam la btags/dkar phyogs kyi sde brgyad bran du bkol/lugs gsum mi 'gyur lhun grub kyi gtsug lagalha yul rtsa gsum gyi bkod pa la/mi yul rten gsum gyi lang tsho'i phra btab pa bzhengs/phyogs kyimakhas pa du ma dang /bod kyi lo tsā du mas bshad nyan 'gyur gsum gyi chos grwa btsugs/—43

bya ba legs nyes kyi spang blang ston pa gtsug lag rtsis kyi sgo mo/nad pa'i zug zer gcog pa thugs rje sman gyi bstan bcos/'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa/dkar 'jam yug gcig tu brdal nas/chos theg dgu 'dzom pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i lus tshang ba/grub mtha' nga khyod kyiphyogs ris med pas/bstan pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa/bshadasnabazung du 'brelabasamakhasagrubaganyisaldan du 'byung ba/mdo sngangs zung du 'chad pas lta spyod ya ma bral ba'i/snga 'gyur rnying ma'i chos zhes grags chen don dang ldan pa/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gzhi btings/sad mi mi bdun la sogs bsnyen par rdzogs/bstan pa'i gzhi ma chos 'dul ba rin po che'i srol btod/rab byung btsun pa'i sde dang gos dkar lcang lo'i sde zhes/mchod gnas kyi sde gnyis su mdzad de dge 'dun gyi grwa btsugs/bon zhang zhung gi grub mtha' lugs gnyis/—slo

zung 'jugagi khrims kyis tshar bcad/phyi rol mu stegs kyi rgyu 'grul/bka' srung bstan ma'i phrin las kyis mtshams bcad/rgyal bstan yid bzhin gyi nor bu phyi ma'i mthar yang nyams pa med pa'i/mdzad phrin rtsibs stong gi 'khor los sna drangs/'dzam bu'i gling sum gnyis kyi rgyal srid rang dbang du byas nas/chos srid zung 'jug gi snang ba 'gran zla dang bral bar mdzad/bar skabs su bstan palidar nub ci rigs pa zhig byung yang /dbon sras sprul pa'i btsan po 'phags chen lag na rdo rje/lha gcig khri sde srong btsan bod kyi rgyal por phebs te/chos thams cad skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/bka' dang bstan bcos yongs su rdzogs pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas/bka' gtsigs dkar chags kyis mnan pa la sogs/sangs rgyabakhakyi bstan pa la phyag bzhes 'gran zla dang bral ba/—43

yab mes kyi dus las kyang lhag pa mdzad/skabs de tsa na dpon srasa.u dum btsan po'i/thugs la gdon gsol gyis thebs pas/sangs rgyas kyi bston pa rin po che cung zad sma phab ste/bod dbus gtsang gi yul gru na rab byung mi mthong bar byas kyang /sku tshe mthar ma phyin te mtshon grir gshegs/gsang sngags 'bras bu'i theg pa'i rang lam nas grub pa/brnyes pa'i 'phags chen bgrangs yas su bzhugs pa'i bka' drin las/chos theg pa chen po mdo sde bslab pa gsum dang /gsang sngags bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa/bka' dang bstan bcos zung du 'brel bar nyams med du bsdokyigs/dmar g.yo gtsang gsum du grags pa'i mer ba'i grub chen rnam gasdo/ma/—46

mdo khams smad na bzhugs pa la/shākya dge ba rab gsal rab tu byung ste bsnyen par rdzogs/de las dbus gtsang mi bcu la sogs par mched de/bstan pa'i gzhi ma chos 'dul ba rin po che/smad 'dul rnying ma'i lugs srol tshugs/bde gshegs snang ba mtha' yas kyi rnam rol/sprul pa'i dge slong du bstan pa lha cigadi ba ka ra tho lding sprul pa'i lha khang du spyan drangs/lha chos bdun ldan gyi chos 'khor rgyun mi chad du bskor te/byang chub kyi sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis la/chos thams cad kyi lag len bsdus/bod gangs can gyi 'gro ba rgyal ba'i sras po khyu gcig tu byin gyis brlabs/phyi 'dul ba'i spang blang gi tshul mdzesashing /nang byang chub sems kyi bslab pasargyud grol te/gsang ba gsang chen gyi theg pas grub pa brnyes pa'i/—47

jobobaka'agadamasapa zhesaphyidar mibastan palithog mar byung /de nas mar pa chos kyi blo gros dang /rdzos sangasargyasaganyisapa'i dngosaslob 'khon wo klu'i dbang po/sa skya paṇa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan sogasakyis/mkhas pa'i tshul/ btsun pa'i tshugs/grub pa'i rtags bsam gyis mi khyab pas/mtha' 'khob kyi yul khamasachos la bsgyur te/rgya bod hor gsum du rgyal ba'i bstan pa/yid bzhin nor bu'i mnga' bdag tu bzhugs/de nas rje btsun bstan pa'i 'khor lo/rig grol sprul ba'i dge slong /rje blo bzang gragasapa shar myong kha'i yul gru/rgya bod gnyis kyi sa mtshams su sku zhabrungs/garma pa rol ba'i rdo rje las rab tu byung rte/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rtagasakyi che ba'i/phyi 'dul ba'i phyag bzhesal thog mar sbyangs/ —48

jo bo bka' gdams pa'i brgyud 'dzin/chosarjedonagrub rin chen lathu da la267rimapagasanate/rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje nor bulirgyan la/gtsugs su byas te spyod phyogs rgya che'i gzhung bsrings/dpal ldan sa skya'i mkhas pa gzhen nu blo gros las/zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba rnam dpyod rigs lam gyis gzhal ba'i/man ngag thos pa'i mtha' rgya bcad de/zab mo lta ba'i lugs la 'gran zla dang bral/gsang sngag rnying ma'i grub chen/lho brag nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan las/chos nyid gcer mthong du ston pa'i/nyams len gnad kyi ngo sprod zhus te/thugs kyi dogs pa thams cad yongs su bcad nas/gdams ngag tshig gcig tu 'dus pa rang bzhin/rdzoṭa pa chen po'i nyams len byin brlabs kyi rgyud las/grub pa'i samathor gsheṭa ba'i thosagrol cig char du gyur pas/49

de yang ji skad du/las kyi rdo rje bla ma'i mchogablo bzang grags pa slob ma'i mchogabadud rtsi sman mchog chos kyi mchogaces ched du brjod pa'i ngo mtshar gyi gleng gzhi/'gran zla bral ba'i rol mo dkrol te/rgyal bstan yongs su rdzoṭa pa'i mnga' bdag tu gyur/gzhud lugabatanadams par shar ba dang /bstan pa 'gal med du rtogs pa'i rnam dpyod/bla na med pas byang chub lam gyi rim pa dang /mdo sde rgyu 'bras kyi chos dang /zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba zung du 'dzug pa'i/man ngag nyams len gyi khrid tshul rnam par dag pas/thun mong gi gdul bya rjes su 'dzin zhing /gsang sngaṭa lam gyi rim pa bshad pa rgyud dang 'brel zhing /nyams len gdams ngag dang 'brel ba/—50

sku rgyud 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i bskyed rdzoṭa dang bcas pa/dbang rnon tse gcig gis grol ba'i nye lam ston zhing /yang gsang bla na med pa'i lta sgom rtsol byas las/'das pa'i snyan rgyud gdams pa'i gang zagashin tu dbang rnon thos grol cig char du byed pa'i/man ngag rtoṭa ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho la sogs/skal bzang gi skyes bu rnams la yang /gsang thugs kyi man ngag tu gnang nas/lha ldan smon lam chen mo la soṭa bstan 'gro la phan pa'i/bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 'gran zla dang bral bar mdzad/'brog ri bo dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling btab/phyi 'dul ba'i kun spyod gtsang ma'i sbyang ba'i/yon tan bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i spyod pa/mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i sgol bskyangs te/rgyal ba dgyes pa'i mdzad pa lhur len pa las/chosabargyad don du gnyer ba'i mi chen gyi lad mo mi mdzad/

nang du byang chub sems kyis thugs rgyud yongs su grol te/snying rje chen po'i khur 'dzin zhing pha rol phyin pa'i/spyod pa la dgyes(pa'i gzhan phan 'ba' zhig lhur len pa las/phyogs 'dzin gyi 'khrugs pa slong ba dang /mnga' 'bangs tshar gcod kyi dbang bsgyur ba la sogs/gzhan gnod gzhir bcas la rtsa ba nas mi dgyes/gsang chen rdo rje theg palibaskyed rdzoṭa nyams len gyi gdams pa'agi/grub pa'i sa mthor gshegs te chos nyid blo bral du rtoṭa pas/tshul khrims mchog 'dzin gyi gol sa dang /yid dpyod rtsol bcas kyi lta ba la blo phug mi gtad pa'i/rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i zhal skyin bzhugs te/skal bzang las ldan gyi slob rgyud chos mthun dam pa'i/rjes 'jug bgrang ba las 'das pa byung zhing rgyal ba'i/bstan gzhi bzhengasasu slong b.libadag rkyen bla na med pa mdzad/mthun 'jug lto gos la lta ba dang /—52

chags shang chos brgyad la wo pa'i dus mtha'i/rab byung gdul bar dka' ba'ang rje 'di nyid kyi mas tsam/rna bar son pa rgyu mas du byas te/grub mtha' 'dzin pa sa rsā tsho rdul las kyang mang ngo /de nas kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po klong ོ rab stims/zugar tsho〉(tshog zugar tshothe/:rdo'ajam pa' rda 'a rnam par 'phrul pa grub pa' rda 'an pa/g.yo ༅ 'i phu ru sku stings/chung dus nas sangasargyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i/rjes su tsosate khyim pa'i rtags dor/bla brang ba chos dpal rgyal mas la sogs/mkhas pa du ma'i legs gad la gsan bsam mdzad de/chos sde snod gsum/ g.yi gad pa/lam nyams len/ gzhi semasabaskyed//sdithagaX/da skyodzadabababad zas95gran/zla/ ra/yang dag pa'i 6kyi gter rsā po la dbang bsgyur te/ba na pa thamasacad kyi gnad ston cing /

'od gsal rdzoṭa pa chen po'i grub mtha' gtso bor ston pa/mdzod chen bdun/ snying jig ya bzhi/ngal gso skor gsum/ rang grol skor gsum la sogs/rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gi bka' dngos dang khyad par med pa'i/bstan bcos bsam gyis mi khyab pas bstan pa spyi dang /khyad par 'od gsal rdzoṭa pa chen po'i bstan gzhi bzhengs su bslangs/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i bdag por bzhugs/de nas kun mkhyen bla ma 'jigs med gling pa/g.yo ru yul midabus su sku'i skye ba bzung /lo gsum du nyamasalen chig sgril du mdzad pas/rang byung gi rtogs pa rgyud la skyes/chos thams cad ma bslab par shes/kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po rig 'dzin mimed 'od zer gyi zhal/lan gsum du mjal te ye shes kyi sku yis rjes su bzung /bstan pa thams cad kyi bdag por dbang bskur/—54

chos thams cad dgongs brgyud gcig tu byin gyis brlabs te/rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ba nas bzung ste/stod rgya gar gyi yul gru man chad/smad rgya nag gi chu mtha' yan chad kyi mnga' ris skor gsum/mdo khams sgang drug dbus gtsang ru bzhi/mon kha sna bzhi/ rgyal mo rong gi rgyal khag bco brgyad/o rod sde ba tsho bzhi/ bod sde sbra nag khag gsum tshun chad/chos rgyud dang slob brgyud kyis gang /rnying ma'i rang rkang ma nor ba'i kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i/chos lugs zhes bstan pa thams cad kyi gnad tshang ba/man ngag thams cad kyi bcud 'dus pa/rgyud sde thams cad kyi snying phyung ba/bshad pa dang sgrub pa zung du 'jug pa'i/chos nyid gcer mthong du rtogs/chos can rten 'brel du shes pas zab pa las kyang /zab pa'i grub mtha' kun gyi rtse mor gyur ro/—53

da mas gtam 'jig rten gyi lugs dang sbyar na/gong na rje yi gdung rabs/'og na 'bangs kyi mi rabs/stong sde srid pa'i chags tshul dang gsum yod la/bskal rabs bzhi yi dang po/'dzam gling chags nas ring por ma lon pa'i gnas skabs na/steng na dpon med de mi la drag zhan med/'og na 'bangs med de dbul po'i tha snyad med/de'i skabs na mi thams cad nam mkha' la 'gro/bdud rtsi yi zas za/rdzu 'phrul gyi rta zhen/rang 'od kyis snang ba byed pa'i bskal pa/rjenags ldan dang po zhes grags la/de nas rim gyis za thang dang bsod namasa'aphri/'bras swā lu'i zhing la spyod paliskabs su byung ste/zhing la bgo bsha' byas/—56

rang gzhan gyi phyogs 'dzin byung /rgyal po la snga ba mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po byung ste/rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po/bgrang dka' ba byung ba nas dri med shākya'i rgyal rgyud ces/rgyal rigs kun gyi mchog tu grags so/de nas bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'di la ni/dang po yul khams rgya mtshor gnas pa las/rim gyis ljongs su chagasate mi dang mi min gyi 'gro bas/gang bar mched pa las rim pa bzhin du/dang po mi min gyi dbang du byas te/ma sang spun dgu yis rim par dbang bsgyur/bar du mi yi rje la snga ba gnya' khri btsan po/gnam lha yi yul nas dmu skas thems pa las brgyud de/mgo nag bod kyi rgyal po la phebs pa nas/gnam la khri bdun/ sa la legs drugabar la btsan lnga/ tshig la sde brgyad/—57

skyid pa'i gdung rabs bcu gsum/lhan tu skyid pa'i gdung rabs lnga/rgyal rabs sil ma bcu drug tu graṭa pa sogs du ma byung /de dag las khyad par du gyur pa/chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi ring la/chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa 'jam la dam pa/rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing sbram la lci ba'i/lugs gnyis khrims kyi srol btod/ngan byed la chad pa bcad/bzang byed la gtang rag byin/mkhas blun la khyad par phyes/ya rabs kyi gasdosang bsrangs/ma rabs kyi srol bsnubs/bka' gtsigs kyi yi ge bris te/bod khrims med la khrims kyi srol btod/mi dpon med la gzhog ga'i dpon bskos/—58

rgyal rabs kun las 'gran zla dang bral bar gyur te/lha sras brgyud pa gsum gyi ring la yab mesakyi srol bzung /de nas glang dar ma.u dum btsan po yis/chos khrims kyi srol bsnubs/rgyal khrims 8/gas kyibasazhigargyal rabs sil bur 'thor/gong dpon la spyi khrimasamed paliganas skabs na/lha sras rtse sde yi brgyud pa las/stod mnga' ris skor gsum la dbang bsgyur te/bod bye brag la dbang b.lirgyal po rim par byon te/lugasaganyis kyi srol rim par dar/phyi nas 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phagasapa/gnam se chen rgyal po'i dbu bla la phebasate/bod khri skor bcu gsum dbang yon du phul/bod spyi la dbang ba'i dpon chen shākya bzang po soṭa bskos te/khrimasasrol hor dang bstun pas/—59

bzang la gtang rag dang /ngan la chad pa byas/mgar blon rig pa can gyi bu brgyud/mdo khams smad kyi yul grur byon te/sde dge bla ma zhes mtshan snyan gyi cod paṇa dang /legs byas kyi dbu 'phang gsar du 'bos te/smad gling khamabasakyi yulaX/ phal cher la dbang bsgyur/smad shar sde 'brog palimi rgyud dang /lho rong sde zhing gi bdag po rdzong khag nyi shu rtsa lnga/stong sde khri skor mang po'i rgyal por gyur te/gong ma gnam gyi rgyalapolibaka' shel dam lag tu bzhagathob 'phru tog mgo la btsugs/sde rang thob ho bcu la bris nas/bskos pa rgyasamadzad kyang /mdzad pa bod kyi srol du byasate/bod snga rabs chos rgyal mes dpon rnam gsum gyi/—60

khrims srol rgyun bskyangs te nyes can la chad pa byas/sdig can la khrims lung bstan/rkun po la chad 'jal len/mi bsad la rgyu stong 'jal/bsad pa dang rku ba nyes pa'iche shogasu byas te/dge ba bcu yi khrims btsugs/lnga la lnga dpon dang bcu la bcu dpon/sde la spyi dpon dang yul la rdzong dpon bskos te/rgyal rabs rim par brgyud pa nas/'di ni steng na rje'i gdung rabasazhesazer/da ni 'og na 'bangs kyi mi rabasazer ba de/sa bcad ma btang ba tsam cung zad 'chad na/spyir phyi snod kyi 'jig rten mas nas yar chags/nang bcud kyi sems can yasanasamar chags/srid rtse bsam gtan gyi lha lasazag bcas nam mkha' la brten pa'i/—61—

'dod pa'i lha rigasadrug tu sate/gling gsum 'od gsal lha lasachad/byang gling rtsa gsum lha las chad de/bar gling bzhi srid pa'i mi nga /de las kyang lho 'dzam bu gling pa/bsod nams4 kyiyulagru/bde skyid lasakyi sapa/skal bzang thub pa'igadul /stod rgya gar lha las chad de/dpal dang riṭa gabazang /ya rabs kyi srol mang /mkhas pa'i rig pa rtsi/lha chos kyi grol phugs su byung /smad rgya nag klu las chad de/nor dang longs spyod che/khyad nor gyi yo byad mang /—62

phyug po yi zas gos la rtsi/khrims srol gyi grol phugs su byung / bar sog sde lha min las chad de/dpa' rtsal dang brtul phod che/mtshon cha'i sgyu thabs la mkhas/dpa' bo dang ha shag la rtsi/dmag 'thab kyi grol phugs su byung /bod gdong dmar spre'u dang brag srin las chad de/mi dang 'dre ru 'brel/kha yang la zhe gnagarigs sngon byung dang bstun pa'i bod mi'u gdung drugastod mnga' ris skor gsum rdzing lta bu/bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi yur ba lta bu/smad mdo khams sgang drug zhing salta bu rte/bod thugs rje chen po'i gdul zhing du gyur/sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dkar 'jam du dar/rgya gar mkhasapa'i bstan bcos/—63

bod rje rgyal po'i khrims srol/rang sde yul gyi spyi srol/'dra la khyad chos mang ba'i mi chosakyi lugs ka shes/lha chos kyi lo rgyus zhib/pho mkhas na pho rtsal sna dgu dang /nyams mtshar ba'i rtsed mo sna dgu/mi ya rabs kyi dam pa'i gnas lnga zhes/sgyu rtsal la gzhi bcol/zas gos la rgyan byas/longs spyod la 'phel rtsi/mkhas pa'i grags pa 'don/bzang po'i yon to bstod/lha chos rgya gar dang bstun/tshong chos rgya nag dang bstun/g.yul 'khrugs hor sde dang bstun/khrims srol rang lugs su skyong ba'i/bod gangs can gyi lha sde mang la rgya che/—64

bzang la gral 'dzom/mthun la ya rabs pa sha rtog tu byung rte/pho byung tshad 'phags pa'i dge bsnyen dang /mo byung tshad chos kyi lha mor gyur bas/byis pa lo gsum gyi dus nas/a ma dang ma ṇi mnyam du zlos pa'i/bstan pa la ma zhugs pa'i gang zag med la/dkon mchog la mi dad pa'i grub mtha' med pas/bod thugs rje chen po'i zhing khams zhes/khyad par 'phags pa'i gtam srol du byung la/de las kyang pho brang dmar poriri la chos srid zung du 'jug pa'i/rgyal khrims lha chos su bskyangs pas/mi sde las lha sde mang / minag lasarab byung mang /lha shākya mu ne ston palirgyal tshab tu bzhugs pas/phyogs kyi rgyal po sde bzhis dad 'dun gyi rang dbang byed/mtha' bzhi yi nor sna mang /—65

phyogs bzhi yi tshong 'dus che/phyug po yis skyong sla/med po yis btsal sla/nyo tshong gis sgrub sla/zas gos kyi rigs mang /ster slong gi srol yod/phyogs bzhi'i mi sna du ma bod sde'i yul du mched de/shar rgyal rong gi yul gru bod lha chos kyi sde la yar 'du/byang hor sog gi rgyal khams chos dad gtong ba'i yon bdag tu byung /smad mdo khams sgang drug phal mo che ba/stobs ldan sde dge rgyal po'i chab 'og tu 'du ba'i/rong sde rdzong khag nyer lnga/'brog sde sto rdza gnyis zhesapa'i/byang rdza chu'i klung 'gram du mi la dpon byung ste/lha rje rdza rgyal btsan po lha ming mi la 'phos/shar gser g.yu yi gzhud nas/—66

gdung lha sde dkar mo rje la dpon rigs sum cu/gdung zhwa dkar can gyi brgyud pa byung ste/bshad na gtam mkhas la bskor na blo bzang /brtan la gzhung thub/snga tshig gi phug thub pas 'bangs mi sde'i dpon rigs su byung /gong rgyal po'i blon rigs su byung rte/sde rang phyogs kyiskyid sdug la dbang b.lidapon thob sum cu so lnga/nye 'brel ya rabs su 'brel ba'i bzang po'i mi rgyud mi chad/byang phyoṭa hor sog gi yul khamasalo rod tsho chen gyi/mi rigs tsha zhang phyug dar du 'dzom par byung ste/dgra dpa' rtsal gyis 'dul/gnyen zas nor gyis skyong /dpon dpya khral gyis mchod/mi rgyu la heb mi che bas rku jag gis 'gros sna mi mang /rang rgyu la bsogs 'jog mi dman pas/longs spyod kyis phongs pa mi yong /sngar byung gi khrims srol mi snub pas/—67—

gzhung lam la 'pho 'gyur mi yong /nyes byas rje la zhu bas mi dmangs la shi bsad mi mang /dme 'khrugs kyi srol ka med pas/khrims srol la blo gros zhib rte bzang lha gral nas 'don/mkhas tshogs gral nas bshad/bden rang lam du gtong /rdzun nyes chad kyis snub/khrims spyi dpon gyis gtam pa'i mi yul lha la 'gran par byung /de ni 'og na 'bangs kyi mi rabs zhes bya/da ni phyi snod kyi 'jig rten mas nas yar chags zhes bya ste/ye med srid pa dang po'i 'byung bzhi rdul phran du 'dus/gling bzhi rang babs su chags/ri rgyal ri bo chen po rang bzhin du grub ste/shar gyi gling gsum zlum por byung ba la/mi rigs lus bong che bas/shar lus 'phags kyi gling zhes grags te/ri rab kyi shar phyogs shel las grub pas/—68

nam mkha'i kha tog dkar po'i mar zhabs su 'du/byang gling gsum gru bzhi la byung ste bde skyid lha la 'gran/ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras bu bzang /shi ba thams cad lha yul du skye/'chi tshe sgra 'byung bas sgra mi snyan zhes bya ste/ri rab kyi byang phyogs gser las grub pas/nam mkha'i kha tog ser po'i kheb zhabs la gnas/nub gling gsum zla gam gyi gzugs su byung rte/'dod 'jo yi ba la longs spyod pas/nub ba glang spyod ces bya rte/ri rab kyi nub phyogs padma rā ga lasagrub pas/nam mkha'i kha tog dmar po'i yul gru zhes bya/lho gling gsum sog rka'i gzugs su byung ste/'dzam gling las kyi sa pa miriṭa dang skad riṭa mi mthun/bde skyid kyi rnam grangs mi 'dra/bde sdug gi khod mi snyoms/mi la drag zhan byung ste yul chen po drug tu gnas/—69

dbus rgya gar gyi yul khams gos rgyan rten 'brel thams cad/dkar po byed pas rgya dkar po yi tha snyad chags/dbus rdo rje'i gdan drang srong zho 'thung gi rus pa las grub pas/rdo rje'i chos bsnyen gyi rang bzhin tshang pa/rdo rje rgya gram gyi dbyibs su gnas pa'i/ dkyil gyi lte ba la byang chub kyi shing skyes te/skal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi byang chub brnyes pa'i gnas su :/ /pa thams cad stongs kyang chags 'jig med par/nam mkha' la 1sna ba btags pa ltar gnas pas/rgya gar rdo rje gdan zhes lho 'dzam bu gling gi lte ba ru gyur/de las kyang byang nas byang du bgrod pa'i/ri nag po dgu phrag 'das pa'i pha rol na/byang phyoṭa kyi ri bo gangs can yod de/smen shi ba gsos byed kyi bdud rtsi 'khrungs/bcud 'chi ba med pa yi rtsi yis khyab/lha srid pa'i mes po yis dbyar gnas mdzad/—70

brgya byin gyi glang po glang g.yog dang bcas pa/'tsho skyong gi gzan la bkram pa'i gnas na/mtsho chen po ma dros pa kha zheng dpag tshad lnga brgya yod pa'i/shar rta mchog gi kha nas chu lo hi ta dngul gyi phye ma 'dren zhing /chu phran lnga brgya dang bcas pa te/mtsho ma dros pa la lan bdun bskor te shar gyi rgya mtsho la bab/lho glang po che'i kha nas gaṅgā gser gyi bye ma 'dren zhing lho yi rgya ma31ra bab/nub rma bya'i kha nas mis rin po che sna tshogs kyi/bye ma 'dren zhing nub kyi rgya mtshor bab/byang seng ge'i kha nas pakṣu rdo rje'i bye ma 'dren zhing /chu phran lnga brgya dang bcas te mtsho chen po ma dros pa la/lan bdun g.yas phyogs su bskor nas byang gi rgya mtshor bab /shar lho mtshams na lhang 'dzam bu trikta zhes bya ba'i/lhang thog chu nang du lhung pa las 'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser zhes/lan bcu drug tu bzhu brtul byas pa'i gser dang 'dra rte/bzhu khams kyi rin po che'i rgyal por grub pas/ 71

'dzam bu'i gling zhes ming du chags/shar rgya nag gi yul khams longs spyod rgya che/gos rgyan rten 'brel thams cad nag po rtsis su byed pas/rgya nag po'i yul khamasasu grags/nub phyogs yo rgyan gyi yul na he ru ka rang byung gi/lha khangaskusgo rgyan rdu ma tha la zhes bya ste/gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa 'byung ba'i gnas su bston/ma mo dang mkha' 'gro stong gi bzhugs gnas su gyur pa'i/o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling zhes kyang grags te/yul nyer bzhi chagatso bor gyur/byang na rigs ldan sprul pa'i gnas sham bha la/mirigs 'bum phrag drug cu dang /skad riṭa 'bum phrag drug cu riṭa ldan gcig gi mnga' 'khas su 'du/sprul pa lha/rgyal pos lo brgya brgya rer chos ston/dpal dusakyi'akhor lo'i bskyed rdzogasakyi/—72

nyams len la brtson pa'i grub pa'i rnal 'byor mang /bar bod khams kyi yul gru/ri gangs ri dkar po'i phreng pas bskor te/gangs ldan nyi shu rtsa gcig lha rigs/dge bsnyen du gnas pas yul la dbang byed/ri mtho bsil la dwangs pas mi rgyud rig pa bzang /yul la dge bcu tshang bas yon tan phun sum tshogs/chu bo dwangs la bsil bas 'du ba rang bzhin gyis snyoms/drod grang gi sngo sna tshang pas bdud rtsi'i sbyor sde 'dzoms/mi thams cad legs pa'i lam la dga'/chu thams cad shar gyi phyogs su 'bab/ri thams cad gangs dkar gyis g.yogadus bzhi'i rnam 'gyur gsal la mnga' thang dang longs spyod che/bza' shing dang 'bras bu mang la phyuṭa lug la rtsa gzan mod/stod lha chos kyi yul na lha ldan sprul ba'i gtsug lagapho brang po ta la dang ra sa 'phrul snang gi lha khang /rin po che brgya dang rtsa brgyad las grub pa'i/—73

jo shag rnam gnyis kyis brjod du med pa'i chos ston zhing /thub pa dngos kyi rgyal tshabagasu bzhugs/pho brang dga' bzhi'i 'phrul snang / gser btul ma'i rgya phub mjal bas kyang /mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skye/lugs gsum bsim yas kyi gtsug lag khang /steng rgya gar dang bar li yul 'og rgya nag gi luṭa su bzhengs te/bka' sde snod gsum gyi bstan pa'i chos/ sgrub pa'i lha/brgyud pa'i bla ma dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thuṭa kyi rten gsum/mthong bas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la reg pa'i ngo mtshar gyi bkod pa baspra//smad mdo khams kyi yul gru/chu thams cad bsil la dwangs/lhang thams cad drang la ldem/spang thams cad snum la bkra/zhing thamasacad phyug la gshin/rong sde dang 'brog sde 'brel/—74

bza' btung gi rtsol sgrub sla/ar jag gi rgyu 'grul nyung /sa gzhi kha rgya che la lung pa phu thag ring /sa dpyad bzang dgu 'dzom/lha chosagatsug lag gi dpyad 'dzom pas/dge 'dun gyi sde kun dar rgyas che/mi chos pho brang gi legs dgu 'dzom pas/rgyal rabs srid chus brtan zhing mnga' thang dang longs spyod rgyas/phal ba dur mtsher 'debs sa legs pas/mi phyugs yar ldan du 'phel/gang yang phun sum tshogs pas yul la dge bcu tshang ba rte/stong sde srid pa'i chags tshul zhes bya ba de de tsam zhig red//—73—

bag gos la bshad pa mu tig phreng mdzes/༈ ཿ( bde legs su gyur cigade ring bkra shis pa'i nyi ma/phun sum tshogs pa'i skar ma/bde legs 'byung ba'i dus tshod/gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi 'og na/sa padma 'dab brgyad kyi steng na/smad rgya nag rgyal po'i rgya mkhar 'dra ba/stod dbus gtsang bla ma'i chos ra 'dra ba/gdung tshang gi khyim gzhi g.yang khyim nang du/tshangs pa dkar po 'dra ba'i a zhang gis/dgung nyi ma dang 'dra ba'i bag gos bskon na/dusathog mar bag gos lo rgyus bshad dgos/dgung nyim dang 'dra ba'i bag gos 'di/ —76

lug g.yang dkar brgya yi bal phud yin/ma sru mo brgya yi lag phud yin/rgya 'thag mkhan brgya yis btags pa yin/bzo ba kong tse rgyal po yis/gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la dpe blangs nas/rtsibs brgyad po 'dra ba'i gong ba dras/gong ba 'bor lo bskor 'dra red/bar rin chen cha brgyad la dpe blangs nas/rin chen cha brgyad dang 'dra ba'i gso ring dras/gso ring gos dar dpyangs 'dra red/sa padma 'dab brgyad la dpe blangs nas/'dab brgyad po 'dra ba'i 'dabs chon dras/'dabs chon 'ja' tshon shar 'dra red/gangs seng ge dkar mor dpe blangs nas/seng dkar mo 'dra ba'i rgyab gzhung dras/khog stod gangs seng 'gying 'dra red/

bya rgyal khyung la dpe blangs nas/khyung gshog pa 'dra ba'i phu rung dras/phu rung khyung chen 'phur 'dra red/g.yu 'brug sngon mor dpe blangs nas/'brug g.yu lo 'dra ba'i nang chon dras/nang chon g.yu 'brug 'khyil 'dra red/mdzub gu gser gyi thur ma la/mdzub dkri nam mkha'i skar ma bskon/sa le sbram gyi khab mig la/bzo skud dngul skud phra mo brgyus nas/bag gos rin chen bzos pa yin/rang byon 'dra ba'i na bza' la/lugs g.yang dkar brgya yi rin gong dang /'bri thul ma brgya yi rin gong dang /rta 'do ba brgya yi rin gong gis/nyos nas bag ma lus la bskon/—78

lag pa g.yon pas g.yon nas gon/rgyu nor zas gsum 'bab sa yin/sgo khar phyugs kyis 'geng rgyu red/bang mdzod rgyu yis 'geng rgyu red/05ga pa g.yas pas g.yas sdo/ be|na/lang tsho dpa' rtsal dar rgyu red/phyi'i dgra mgo bo gnon rgyu red/mdor na kha las me lce 'bar 'bar dang /rlung rta rta rgod rgyugs rgyugs byed nges yin/—79

bag rta la bstod pa dri za'i rgyud mang /༈ ཿsna legs so/'do ba lha rta dkar po 'di nyid la/srog chags bdun gyi bgo bo tshang /ya mgal po ti brtsigs 'dra la/ma mgal 61gas nas btags 'dra yod/sbal ba rgya bo'i mig sgam la/a bra skya mo'i mig 'bras yod/rna rtse bdud kyi so ba la/sna khung jag pa skung sa yod/sog pa mdzo rgan sha shor la/dpung ba lug thong bkyigs 'dra red/lag ngar spyang mo 'dur shes la/ske zheng ber gyi phu rung yod/—80

mgo spyi gtsug rus pa'i mchod rten la/sha rdog tsam zhig med par bzang /thod pa'i me long steng ma la/nas bre gang nyi mar bskam sa yod/stod lhu bzhi'i 'then thag ze na yod/ze lab tse bzhin du mtho na bzang /smad lhu bzhi'i 'then thag nywa na yod/nywa rgya zor bzhin du bkug na bzang /sngon nas bltas na had se yod/sha yu mos khyi skad nyan pa 'dra/zur nas bltas na mer se yod/'brong bre ser rdza nas 'angs pa 'dra/rgyab nas bltas na skur se yod/mgo skur te rgum 'bu ba 'dra/lag rmig pa phu nu nang 'khor de/ri chen pa' ngos la 'gos na bzang /—81—

rkang rmig pa rgya zangs kha bsgor de/thang chen po'i dkyil nas brgyugs na mgyogs/brang zheng thang dkar gshog brgyangs de/rgyugs ya nam mkha'i bya las med/thod gtsug nor bu pang leb de/dpa' bo rnams kyi zhon rta red/ske gtsug nyi zla kha sprod de/bla ma bzang bo'i zhon rta red/dung gtsug dor bu sum 'dzug de/tshong dpon nor bzang zhon rta red/lung gtsug ta len mgo bsdu de/bag ma bzang ba'i zhon rta red/mchan rtsib sha ba mda' 'khrur de/rngon pa bzang bo'i zhon rta red/mdor bsdus na rta rab gcig la 'dzomasadagos pa ni/gnyis ring gcig thung / bzhi phra gzugs che zhes/—82
sa pa dang shā sa pa dang skredi/ pa cung

gsol mchod dpyid kyi rgyal mo/༈ snyed bde legs su sdo/ra cigarin po che sna bdun las grub pa'i zangs snod/tshur bltas phar mi mthong /phar bltas tshur mi mthong /gzhu 'dom stong gis gzhal yang cha tshad mi lon pa'i/snod shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba/kha na mi 'jig g.yung drung yod pa/rked na bkra shis rtags brgyad yod pa/zhabs na padma 'dab brgyad yod pa/steng na 'bri mar ser po'i kha rgyan yod pa/'og na padma 'dab brgyad kyi gdan yod pa/de yi nang du rdza chu dwangs mo'i gtso byed pa'i/gangs seng ge dkar mo brgya yi 'o ma/—84

'bri ze dkar brgya yi 'o ma/lug 'tsher mo brgya yi 'o ma/lho g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i kha chu/stod rgya gar yul gyi bdud rtsi/smad rgya nag yul gyi sman rtsi/bod gangs can yul gyi chang rtsi sogs/dkar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtsho/mngar gsum sbrang rtsi'i rdzing bu/bdug spos dud sprin gyi phang phung /snang gsal nyi zla'i gur khyim/dri chab bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/zhal zas li khri'i lhun po bcas/phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin ma tshang ba med pa/bshams dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yod a/ཿda legs so/da de ring bkra shis pa'i nyi ma la/—85

phun sum tshogs pa'i bdud rtsi 'di mchod pas/bde legasa'abyung ba'i mchod g.yang zhig 'bod na/dngos grub kyi gter mdzod rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs la/'bul lo/ mchod do/ bzhes par gsol lo/gnas mchog nyi shu rtsa bzhi na 'khod pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo/ma mkha' 'gro'i sde dpon dang bcas pa la/'bul lo/ mchod do/ bzhes par gsol lo/stod mnga' ris skor gsum/bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/smad mdo khams snang drug na 'khod pa'i/yab 'o de gung rgyal dang srasayar klungs sham po/gtsosamadzad pa'i srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu/rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum/lha mo tshe ring mched lnga/bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma bcu gnyis rnamasal/'bul lo/ mchod do/ bzhes par gsol lo/—86

rje dpon rma chen sbom ra/gangs dkar shel gyi lhun po/gnam sngon thang la babs 'dra'i/mtsho chen khri 3tsher rgyal mo/gzhan sde zil gnon mu nda/gangs dkar phyogs las rnam rgyal/ri bo dge ldan pa'i bla ri/a skyes myong kha'i skyes ri sogs la/'bul lo/ mchod do/ bzhes par gsol lo/khyad par du shar stod bzhag brag dkar po/chos skyong srung ma'i gtso bo/nor lha rgya mtsho'i snying nor/dgra lha yongs kyi rgyal po/wer ma yongs kyi srog snying /sde brgyad yongs kyi spyi rje/dregs pa yongs kyisrog bdag—87

dkar phyogs yongs kyi kha 'dzin/skye bo yongs kyi dgra bla/sems can yongs kyi dpal mgon/rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing /ban bon yongs kyi rgyab rten/bdud 'dul las kyi dbang phyuganag phyogs kun kyi gshed ma/dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/bdud srin kun gyi shan pa chen po/sku dgyes pa'i gar gyis srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa/gsung rngams pa'i 'brug sgras khams gsum dbang du sdud pa/thuṭa 'og gsal klong nas mkhyen brtse'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa/dran pa tsam gyis byin rlabs dngos grub lhan ltar 'du ba/brten pa'i mi la rna mi chung ba/bcol ba'i las la ngo mi ldog pa/bkra shis shing snying nye ba/—88

byin rlabs che zhing mthu rtsal myur ba/las mtha' bzang zhing phug btsan pa/bde nas bde ba byang chub chen po lam du 'dren pa/dngos grub gnyis kyi gter mdzod chen po/shar stod bzhag brag dkar po la/'bul lo/ mchod do/ bzhes par gsol lo/da de ltar dgyesabazhin bzhes shing /longs su spyod pa la brten nas/gdung dang sde ba khag gnyis gtso byas pa'i/bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la/bkra shis pa'i snang ba dgung nas ston cigaltasangan pa'i mun pa dbyings nas sol cigadagra byung na nye sa nas brda thongs shigand byung na ring sa nas dar dbyugs cigabrag lam med la lam gyis lhagachu zam med la zam tshugs lhag—89

bros pa'i rdza gseng gyis shigagab pa'i tshang tshing gyis shiga'adug pa'i mkhar rdzong gyis shigasra ba'i gos khrab gyis lhaganyin thun gsum gyi bya ra mdzod cigamatshan thun gsum gyi srong ma mdzod cigamador na bdag cag gar 'gro gar 'dug kyang /ci bsam yid bzhin 'grub pa la/sdong grogs dang rgyab skyor rgya chen po mdzod cigade ni skabs su babs palimachod g.yang 'bod pa nyung sdud tsam red//—90

shis brjod bkra shis g.yang 'khyil/༈ ཿtho bde legs su gyur cigad stod rma chen 'di gnas kyi bdag po/shar bzhag brag 'di gangs kyi bdag po/phyi rgya mtsho 'di chu yi bdag po/sa dog mo 'di gter gyi bdag po/bod gangs can 'di rten 'brel gyi bdag po yin pas/ngas phun sum tshogs pa'i dus 'di la/ngas rten 'brel gyi kha g.yang zhig 'bod na/de ring rten 'brel gyi snying bo la/dbus lha sa chos kyi ra ba na/chos bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel yod/sgra tshad ma sbyong gi rten 'brel yod/gnas bcu phrag 'phel ba'i rten 'brel yod/stod 'brog sa g.yang gi ra ba na/—91—

phyugs nor g.yang 'khor ba'i rten 'brel yod/rta nor lug 'phel ba'i rten 'brel yod/dkar mar chur mang ba'i rten 'brel yod/smad rong sa 'bru yi ra ba na/zas 'bru g.yang 'khor ba'i rten 'brel yod/'bru lo legs thob pa'i rten 'brel yod/rgyu longs spyod 'dzoms pa'i rten 'brel yod/dus de ring gtam gyi ra ba na/nged a zhang gis bshad pa'i rten 'brel yod/khyod tsha bo yis zhu ba'i rten 'brel yod/chos 'bel gtam de gleng pa'i rten 'brel yod/da rten 'brel gyi snying po smon lam pas/chos pa la chos ra rgyas pa'i smon lam shogashākya'i rgyal brgyud yang yang zhabrungs ba'i smon lam shogabastan pa'i brgyud 'dzin chad rgyu med pa'ismon lam shogasangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzam gling khyab pa'i smon lam shog—92—

dge 'dun mang tshogs sa gzhir gang ba'i smon lam shoga'abrog pa la 'brog lo yag pa'i smon lam shogari mgo khra mo lug gis gang ba'i smon lam shogari sked smug po nor gyis gang ba'i smon lam shogari 'dabs dwangs mo rta yis gang ba'i smon lam shogamar dang chur bsaru mtha' gang ba'i smon lam shogayul la yul lo yag ba'i smon lam rbesnagazhing la lo tog rgyas ba'i smon lam shogalo la 'bru drug smin ba'i smon lam shogabang mdzod 'bru yis gang ba'i smon lam shogagatam pa yi kha lce bde ba'i smon lam shoga'achad pa de rna bar snyan pa'i smon lam shoga'abel gtam de kun gyis shesapa'i smon lam shogami srog brag las sra ba'i smon lam snardzogami brgyud chu las ring ba'i smon lam shogad smon lam gyi snying po bkra shis yin/—93

dbus kyi gtsug lag pho brang dmar po la/phyogs bzhi'i dad ldan 'du ba'i bkra shis shogasngo ljang ne'u gsing rgyas pa'i spang ljongs la/rta nor lug gsum 'phel ba'i bkra shis shogasmad kyi khod snyoms yangs pa'i sa zhing du/'bru drug lo yag yong ba'i bkra shis shoga'adir bzhugs tsha zhang rnams kyi bag gtam de/mdo smad yul du khyab ba'i bkra shis shogamagar thar bod kyi gdung brgyud dkar bo la/mkhas dbang dam pa byon ba'i bkra shis shogarig gnas tshan rig dar ba'i bkra shis shogaphun sum tshogs pa'i pha yul mgar thar 'dir/kun la sdug bsngal mi 'byung ba'i/rgyal bstan dar brlabakra shis shogaphyugs la god kha mi yong ba'i/rtswa chu 'dzoms ba'i bkra shesashog—94

lo la sad ser mi yong ba'i/sa bcud bzang ba'i bkra shis shogami la na tsha mi yong ba'i/bzang drug sman gyi bkra shis shogade ring bkra shis nyi ma la/bkra shis bde legs bkra shis 31gabakra shis kyi bar snang gang /rten 'brel gyi sbrang char 'bab/bsam don gyi lo 'dab rgyas/dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu smin/nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/nyin mo'i gung yang bde legs shing /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/dkon mchog gsum gyis bkra shis shog/ //—95
